svg.title: Z for Z-Card and Accordion Fold
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A bold Z based on the original poster gains a pocket card, which unfolds into a four-panel accordion. The Z moves aside as the Z-Card and Accordion Fold title appears, followed by illustrative pocket card, Z-fold and accordion examples.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop. The original Z and source palette are geometrically redrawn from 26_Z_zine_design.png. All illustrations, typography and animation are embedded. The printed cards shown are fictional concepts, not print-ready dielines.
